business_summary: Rasa Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, trades in and supplies various products in Japan, Singapore, China, Thailand, Asia, and internationally. It operates through six segments: Resources and Metallic Materials, Industrial and Construction Machineries, Environmental Equipment, Chemical Products, Plant and Equipment Construction, and Real Estate Rental. The company imports, exports, and sells mineral sand products, including zircon and rutile sand, ilmenite, and others; industrial materials, such as phosphoric, anhydrous phosphoric, phosphorous acid, second phosphorus finished goods, malp, aluminum hydroxide, polychlorinated aluminum, aluminum sulfate, metallic manganese, metallic silicon and nickel, talc, China clay, silica, boron carbide, electrolytic manganese, and others; and refractory raw materials comprising calcined, low soda, spherical, and other fused alumina, zirconium and lithium compounds, fused spinel, spherical and fused silica power, graphite, black and green silicon carbide, B4C, aluminium hydroxide and others. It also offers industrial machineries, which include pumps, valves, mixers, crushers, strainers, cyclon, pressure washers, rubber joints, and others; construction equipment, such as pipe jacking machines, handheld gas-powered breakers, pipe cutting machines, concrete pumps/mixers, mini crawler cranes, and others; and environmental equipment comprising RASA slag granulation system and PARA-ECO-recycling system. In addition, the company provides plastic synthetic resins and resin additives; sheets, resin films, tapes, and metal foils; extruded and injection-molded materials; oil and fat, and other chemical products. Further, it is involved in the design, installation, and maintenance services for equipment used in oil refineries, petrochemical plants, and other production facilities; and revitalization and leasing of real estate properties. The company was incorporated in 1939 and is headquartered in Chuo, Japan.
business_summary_ko: Rasa Corporation은 자회사와 함께 일본, 싱가포르, 중국, 태국, 아시아 및 국제적으로 다양한 제품을 거래 및 공급하고 있습니다. 자원 및 금속 재료, 산업 및 건설 기계, 환경 장비, 화학 제품, 플랜트 및 장비 건설, 부동산 임대 등 6개 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 지르콘, 금홍석 모래, 티탄철석 등을 포함한 광물 모래 제품을 수입, 수출 및 판매합니다. 인, 무수인산, 아인산, 제2인 완제품, 말프, 수산화알루미늄, 폴리염화알루미늄, 황산알루미늄, 금속망간, 금속규소 및 니켈, 활석, 차이나 클레이, 실리카, 탄화붕소, 전해망간 등의 산업자재; 및 소성, 저소다, 구형 및 기타 용융 알루미나, 지르코늄 및 리튬 화합물, 용융 스피넬, 구형 및 용융 실리카 분말, 흑연, 흑색 및 녹색 탄화규소, B4C, 수산화알루미늄 등을 포함하는 내화성 원료. 또한 펌프, 밸브, 믹서, 파쇄기, 스트레이너, 사이클론, 압력 와셔, 고무 조인트 등을 포함한 산업용 기계도 제공합니다.
